mapper.select: SELECT id, application_no, application_type, applicant_id, department_id, title, total_amount_minor, status, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM applications WHERE id = #{applicationId}

SELECT wi.id AS instance_id, wi.application_id, wi.template_version_id, wi.fixed_workflow_version_key, wi.status AS instance_status, wi.current_node_id, wi.row_version AS instance_row_version, wi.created_at AS instance_created_at, wi.updated_at AS instance_updated_at, wi.completed_at AS instance_completed_at, node.id AS node_id, node.sequence_no, node.node_name, node.approval_mode, CAST(node.rule_snapshot AS CHAR) AS rule_snapshot, node.status AS node_status, node.acted_at AS node_acted_at, node.created_at AS node_created_at FROM workflow_instances wi LEFT JOIN workflow_instance_nodes node ON node.id = wi.current_node_id AND node.instance_id = wi.id WHERE wi.application_id = #{applicationId}

SELECT task.id AS task_id, task.node_id, task.assignee_id, task.status AS task_status, task.opinion AS task_opinion, task.acted_at AS task_acted_at, task.created_at AS task_created_at FROM workflow_instances wi JOIN workflow_instance_nodes node ON node.id = wi.current_node_id AND node.instance_id = wi.id JOIN workflow_node_tasks task ON task.node_id = node.id AND task.status = 'PENDING' WHERE wi.application_id = #{applicationId} AND wi.id = #{instanceId} AND wi.status = 'PENDING' AND wi.current_node_id = #{nodeId} AND node.id = #{nodeId} AND node.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY task.id
SELECT bind.application_id FROM attachments attachment JOIN attachment_binds bind ON bind.attachment_id = attachment.id WHERE attachment.id = #{attachmentId} ORDER BY bind.application_id
